input.text: Create a humanist sans-serif typeface with moderately condensed proportions, consistent stroke weight, a relatively tall x-height, generous counters, slightly rounded terminals, and a conventional double-storey lowercase a. Prioritize readability at small sizes.

brief.text: Create a humanist sans-serif typeface with moderately condensed proportions, consistent stroke weight, a relatively tall x-height, generous counters, slightly rounded terminals, and a conventional double-storey lowercase a. Prioritize readability at small sizes.

resolution.reason: The available semantic constructors do not encode humanist-specific proportions, modulation, or joins.
The planned specimen has no serif components, but its existing constructors are not a validated family style.
No calibrated family-wide width policy currently regenerates the supported constructions.
The specimen reuses a 90-unit stem decision, but optical weight consistency across bowls, joins, and raster sizes is not established.
“Relatively tall” has no calibrated family threshold. The source fixture measures x-height 500 and cap height 700; that measurement is not treated as proof that the request is satisfied.
Only selected enclosed/open spaces exist; there is no cross-glyph counter policy or calibrated meaning for “generous”.
The planned constructors support flat terminals and a bounded chamfer, not rounded terminals.
This goal requires small-size raster review and cannot be resolved by a geometry parameter alone.
A double-storey construction experiment exists, but its saved Android Chrome raster reads as stacked loops rather than a conventional lowercase a. It is excluded from compliant construction planning.
